Application Data.NAME: Smith Leather Goods Inc.
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Smith Leather Goods Inc. specializes in the retail sale of high-quality leather products, including handbags, wallets, luggage, and accessories. Our operations include a well-organized storefront with secure inventory storage, featuring locked display cases and monitored security systems. We also offer in-house repair services for leather goods, ensuring compliance with safety and environmental regulations. In addition to our physical retail location, we have established a secure online sales platform that employs robust cybersecurity measures to protect customer data and transactions. Our commitment to comprehensive loss prevention training for employees minimizes risks related to theft and vandalism, maintaining a safe and secure shopping experience for our customers.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: In the past three years, Smith Leather Goods Inc. experienced one loss on January 10, 2022, due to a break-in where 20 handbags were stolen. The total loss amount was $5,000, and the claim has been closed with no pending issues. There have been no further losses reported since then.
